国际空运普货的英文表述是 （                        )。

请将以下邮件内容翻译为中文：
The situation is now getting even worse, we have to consider the possibility of further delay which may be from customs inspection. Normally, customs entry needs to be done within 24 hours after cargo arrival, while looking at ours, the shipment has been pending for clearance documentation in the past four week. So there's of big chance that customs may impose inspection. The deadline given is to deliver on/before June/1st, we'll definitely miss the target given if we are not able to finish the procedure within the week.
questions.answer: 现在的情况变得愈发糟糕，我们不得不考虑海关查验可能会引起的进一步延误。通常，清关需要在货物抵港后24小时内完成，但是看看我们的货物，在过去的四周一直在等待清关文件，所以有很大可能海关会要求查验货物。给予送货的最后时间是不晚于6月1日，如果本周我们仍然无法完成手续，我们肯定会错过要求的时间。
